name: veil-player
description: Non-normative desktop reference implementation for the VEIL interoperability specification.
author: Allam Zedan

scripts.dist: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis portable
scripts.test:stress: vitest run src/lib/trackSchema.test.ts src/lib/srtParser.test.ts src/lib/maskTransitions.test.ts src/lib/playbackHud.test.ts src/state/useHistoryStore.test.ts
scripts.test:outcomes: vitest run src/lib/nativeDeletionEndToEnd.test.ts src/lib/settingsInteractionStack.test.ts src/lib/inspectorCollapseParity.test.ts src/lib/fullscreenZeroLayerCapabilities.test.ts src/lib/localMediaSeek.test.ts src/lib/subtitleResurrection.test.ts
scripts.qa: npm run css:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.smoke:packaged: npm run verify:build && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/launch-smoke.ps1
